pages.title: Dwellers of the fog
pages.text: The souls differ little from ordinary creatures. The forest even has animals, so food can be found if needed.$(br2)Zombies, skeletons, spiders and other denizens of the Overworld also turn up here.

pages.title: Careful
pages.text: Not every denizen of the Beyond wants to attack. Some simply live their lives.$(br2)But do not forget where you are. Even a calm place may hide something strange.
